items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Erskine Hawkins's band, it was the Alabama State Collegians

ctx.x: But he was the one responsible for bringing the band in, Danny Williams' band in, and you said he'd done something similar before with -- some kind of involvement with Erskine Hawkins. What was that?

That was at Alabama State. Erskine Hawkins's band, it was the Alabama State Collegians, and I thought it was a very nice setup. It's like football players would get scholarships, but you have to work on the campus, if you don't have the money or something, you know, if your family doesn't have the money to pay your way through. And that was the setup that we had, you know?

But Arnold Wright, what kind of a man was he? Was he involved in music in any way? The fact that he set these programs up in two different colleges, he sounds like quite an innovator and a real friend to music.
